title: cAC gravity + hydrostatic pressure + mass conservation with walls (T1 gate S2/S3)

physical_problem.description: Convective Allen-Cahn (cAC) phase-field coupled with Hua-Hu-Chen (HCH) incompressible hydrodynamics under gravity, verifying hydrostatic pressure profile and mass conservation with solid walls.
equations: Phase-field (cAC): ∂_t φ + ∇·(φu) = -M μ + ∇·(λ n̂), where μ = 4βφ(φ-1)(φ-0.5) - κ∇²φ
Hydrodynamics (HCH): ∂_t p + ρc_s²∇·u = 0, ρ(∂_t u + u·∇u) = -∇p + ∇·(μ∇u) + F
Body force: F = μ_φ ∇φ + ρ g (gravity_mode=rho) or F = μ_φ ∇φ + g (gravity_mode=uniform)
Hydrostatic equilibrium: p(z) = p₀ + ρ g z

external_anchor.reference: Liang, Xu, Chen, Wang, Chai & Shi, Phys. Rev. E 97, 033309 (2018)
external_anchor.hydrostatic_law: p(z) = p₀ + ρ g z (classical hydrostatics, any fluid mechanics textbook)
external_anchor.mass_conservation: ∫_Ω φ dV = const for conservative Allen-Cahn with no-flux walls
